sections.title: Scope and operator
sections.text: CreditRepairAI is operated by 3six0 Studios LLC for U.S. adults. This policy describes the native Android app and its supporting services. A companion product is covered only if it expressly links to this policy; another seller's checkout and privacy terms also apply. This review draft must be approved and the operator's monitored support contact supplied before commercial release.

sections.title: Information on your device
sections.text: You select credit-report PDFs for on-device PDF parsing or OCR. The app stores extracted account details, findings, drafts, portal receipts, responses, goals, manual score history, chat, checklist progress and agreement choices in an encrypted case using Android Keystore AES-GCM. Screen capture is restricted and app backup is disabled. These controls reduce risk; they do not guarantee perfect security. Browser downloads and copies you export, paste or share are outside this storage and must be managed separately.

sections.title: App authentication and technical information
sections.text: Firebase processes app sign-in information, account identifiers, email verification, authentication tokens and related technical/security information. Google Sign-In is optional. Authentication and infrastructure providers can receive IP addresses and device or connection metadata. Password handling is performed by the authentication provider; the app does not save passwords in its case. The app never reads, fills, stores or transmits bureau or government-site credentials. Those are entered by you in the official site's browser.

sections.title: Optional AI sharing
sections.text: Before an AI request, a separate disclosure asks whether you allow sharing. With your affirmative choice, CreditRepairAI sends your question and a redacted structured case snapshot over HTTPS through Convex to OpenAI for educational explanations and planning. The snapshot can include bureau names, account/furnisher details with only a last-four suffix, balances, statuses, findings, citations and dispute history. Original report PDFs are not uploaded. Automated redaction can miss unusual identifiers; do not type names, full account numbers, SSNs, birth dates or contact details into AI questions. AI can be disabled while local tools remain available. Withdrawing this choice stops future app requests; it cannot recall information already sent to a provider.

sections.title: Providers, purchases and agreement records
sections.text: Google Play processes subscriptions, one-time purchases and payment details. Convex stores purchase tokens, account association, product, verification state/expiry, hashed dispute bindings for one-time access, and limited administrative audit records needed for access verification and authorized subscription management. The server also stores the current agreement version, document digest, AI-sharing choice and server timestamp against a hashed account identifier. Rate-limit records help prevent abuse. The native app has no advertising or analytics SDK and does not sell case information. We use providers to operate the service, process requested purchases and protect it; we may respond to legal obligations. Providers have their own published retention and processing terms.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
sections.text: Local case data remains until you clear it, sign out, switch accounts or remove the app. Clearing a case destroys its prior encryption key; current agreement/onboarding choices may be saved separately in a newly encrypted empty case. Account deletion removes Convex subscription, one-time purchase, acceptance, rate-limit and relevant audit records, then asks Firebase to delete the login; a recent sign-in may be required. If either step fails, the app reports incomplete deletion and permits retry. A minimal hashed deletion marker remains to block delayed server work from recreating deleted records; it has no reports, purchase tokens or contact details. It currently has no automatic expiry. Qualified review must determine and approve its retention and any necessary legal/security retention before launch.

sections.title: Vendor retention and your choices
sections.text: The OpenAI request uses store:false, but this is not a promise of zero vendor logging or retention. Provider backups, security logs, legal retention and Google Play transaction records follow applicable provider policies and law. Account deletion does not automatically cancel Google Play renewal or delete files from a browser, recipients or external portals. Cancel renewal in Google Play separately; deletion is not conditional on buying anything. You can use Settings to clear a case, delete an account, change AI sharing, and review agreement choices. A public deletion-request page must offer a working support pathway without requiring the app to be reinstalled.

sections.title: Support, children and changes
sections.text: Use the monitored support/privacy contact displayed in the released app or public deletion-request page for access, correction, deletion or privacy questions. Do not send reports, SSNs, passwords or full account numbers to support. We may need proportionate verification of account ownership and will explain any lawful retention. The app is not intended for anyone under 18. Material changes receive a new document version and require fresh affirmative acceptance; additional AI sharing requires its own disclosure and choice. Technical implementation and this policy do not establish legal compliance or a security certification.

sections.title: Agreement, notice and eligibility
sections.text: These Terms govern CreditRepairAI and companion digital content that expressly incorporates this version at download or purchase. Before entering the app workflow, you can read these Terms, Privacy Policy and Educational Disclaimer and must affirmatively select I agree. After that acceptance, each use is governed by the accepted Terms while they remain current. Mere browsing of a policy page does not constitute acceptance, and silence is not consent to changed terms or new data sharing. You must be at least 18 and use only records you own or have lawful permission to use. Do not use the tools if you do not agree; policy access and account-deletion assistance remain available.

sections.title: Nature of the product
sections.text: The tools provide software, general education, draft preparation, organizational guidance and optional AI assistance. They do not create an attorney-client, adviser-client, fiduciary or professional representation relationship. The creator's personal experience and intentions are not professional qualifications. The creator is not presented as a licensed attorney, certified credit counselor or financial adviser, and the app is not staffed by a professional assigned to diagnose your circumstances. It cannot determine all facts, laws, deadlines or causes of your credit situation. Consult an appropriately qualified professional when needed.

sections.title: Your independent choices and submissions
sections.text: Every suggested action is optional. You choose whether to act, revise or disregard it. You are responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of statements you submit, the records and permissions you provide, and your independently chosen actions. Verify extracted fields, citations, identity, supporting evidence and the actual official portal requirements. Findings are prompts for review and do not prove an error. Never fabricate evidence, misstate identity, assert unsupported fraud or identity theft, or dispute information you know to be accurate. The app never enters bureau/government credentials and never submits a dispute or complaint; only you review, copy/paste, attach documents and press the official Submit button. This allocation of responsibility does not remove responsibilities the operator has under applicable law.

sections.title: No outcome guarantee
sections.text: Educational information only — not legal or financial advice. Reports, OCR, analysis, draft text, legal summaries and AI output can be incomplete, outdated or wrong. Do not rely on them as a determination of eligibility, liability, a legal deadline or proof of a reporting error. No deletion, score increase, credit or loan approval, response, resolution or time to an outcome is promised or implied. Reminder dates are check-ins and can be delayed by Android or connection settings. You are not required to follow any suggestion, buy a product, file a dispute or contact a company.

sections.title: Software access, billing and cancellation
sections.text: When enabled after review, monthly or yearly subscriptions purchase access to software tools, AI assistance and education for all your items at the price and renewal interval shown by Google Play. Subscriptions renew until canceled in Google Play. A separate one-time purchase provides AI assistance for one selected saved dispute, including its bureau and CFPB filing guides; it does not renew or unlock other disputes or all-report planning. The purchase is tied to your account and that saved dispute through hashed identifiers. Purchase restoration does not restore deleted local report or dispute data. Local organization and tracking remain available for all items. Google Play shows final pricing and terms before purchase. It does not purchase representation, a deletion, an approval or an outcome; there is no pay-per-deletion or result-based charge. Account deletion and subscription cancellation are distinct. Refund, cancellation, withdrawal and other consumer rights follow applicable law and the applicable store terms. Labeling a product software or education does not create an exemption from credit-services laws. If CROA or state law applies, required disclosures, contracts, payment restrictions and cancellation rights must be implemented before that offering is sold; this general agreement is not a substitute.

sections.title: Acceptable use and third-party sites
sections.text: Do not use the product to impersonate others, harass, deceive, access unauthorized records, share another person's credentials or sensitive data, abuse the AI service, bypass access controls or resell outputs as licensed professional advice. External bureaus, lenders, government sites, browsers, app stores and AI/authentication providers have their own terms and policies. We do not control their decisions or guarantee their availability. You retain rights in your records and grant only the permissions needed to process the information you deliberately supply for the requested functionality; these Terms do not authorize advertising sale of your case information.

sections.title: Limited warranties and liability, only where lawful
sections.text: To the extent applicable law permits, software and educational content are provided as available without warranties of uninterrupted availability, accuracy, fitness for a particular purpose or a particular outcome. To the extent applicable law permits, liability for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages is excluded, and aggregate contractual liability is limited to the greater of US$100 or the software fees you paid to the operator in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim. These provisions do not limit any liability or remedy that applicable law prohibits limiting, including nonwaivable statutory consumer rights, liability for fraud or intentional misconduct, gross negligence where it cannot lawfully be limited, or any other legally nonexcludable responsibility. They do not make the operator immune from claims and do not require you to indemnify the operator for its own unlawful conduct. A qualified reviewer must approve the applicability and wording of this draft before commercial use.

sections.title: Preserved rights, disputes and termination
sections.text: Nothing here waives protections or remedies under CROA, the FCRA, applicable privacy or consumer-protection law, or any other nonwaivable law. You may contact regulators, make truthful reviews, seek qualified advice and exercise rights available to you. No mandatory arbitration or class-action waiver is imposed by this draft. Applicable mandatory law controls where a provision conflicts with it; an unenforceable provision does not reduce mandatory protections. We may suspend abusive or unlawful use subject to applicable law and store/refund obligations. You may stop using the software, cancel renewal, request deletion and keep copies of these Terms. Contact the displayed support address for questions; using support is not a prerequisite to exercising statutory rights.

sections.title: Changes and companion products
sections.text: A material change is presented with a new version for affirmative acceptance before the affected workflow continues. Privacy notices and AI-sharing choices remain distinct from purchasing software. Separate companion digital products are covered only where their checkout or download clearly identifies and incorporates these Terms; their actual seller, price, refund rights and delivery terms must be stated there. Nothing in this draft changes an existing purchase contract retroactively. The operator must confirm its identity, monitored contact, product descriptions and legally required business information before commercial release.

sections.title: Education, discretion and verification
sections.text: Educational information only — not legal or financial advice. CreditRepairAI is a software project informed by its creator's personal experience, not a professional diagnosis of your circumstances. Its creator is not presented as a licensed legal or financial professional. AI answers, parsers, checklists and draft text can be wrong or incomplete. You decide whether to use, revise or disregard each suggestion and must verify every fact, citation, statement and attachment before independently submitting anything.

sections.title: No guarantees or automated action
sections.text: A finding is a review prompt, not proof of an error. We do not guarantee deletions, score increases, approvals, responses, outcomes or timelines. We do not log into bureau/government accounts, fill their forms or submit disputes/complaints. You handle credentials and submission yourself. Never make an allegation you cannot factually support. You may choose another approach or consult a qualified professional; no suggestion or purchase is required.

sections.title: Responsibilities that remain
sections.text: You are responsible for your independently selected actions and truthful submissions, subject to applicable law. This disclaimer does not transfer all legal responsibility to you, waive consumer protections, excuse the operator's unlawful conduct or guarantee immunity from liability. Security measures and redaction reduce risk but are not a guarantee. Read the full Terms and Privacy Policy and make an informed choice about optional AI sharing.
